template: bodies.template(): all phenotypes 0.5, morphological age 35, no local controls, no pose

landmarks.name: cervicale
landmarks.rule: most posterior midline vertex within 2 cm of the neck01 joint height (C7 proxy)

landmarks.name: acromion_l
landmarks.rule: highest vertex within 1.5 cm (x) / 3 cm (y) of the left shoulder joint

landmarks.name: bust_point_l
landmarks.rule: most anterior non-arm vertex, x 3-20 cm, z 68-78% of stature

landmarks.name: waist_front
landmarks.rule: front midline vertex at natural-waist height (min non-arm convex-hull perimeter, z 57-70%)

landmarks.name: waist_back
landmarks.rule: back midline vertex at natural-waist height

landmarks.name: waist_side_l
landmarks.rule: most lateral non-arm vertex within 1 cm of natural-waist height and 3 cm of mid-depth

landmarks.name: buttock_point
landmarks.rule: most posterior non-arm vertex of the left buttock, z 40-56% (max protrusion)

landmarks.name: crotch
landmarks.rule: lowest midline vertex of the trunk

landmarks.name: knee_l
landmarks.rule: most anterior vertex within 2 cm of the knee joint height (mid-patella proxy)

landmarks.name: ankle_l
landmarks.rule: most lateral leg vertex within 1.5 cm of the ankle joint (lateral malleolus proxy)
